name: Vanity collection: Deliver Item hands over the cosmetic items that had no server template
contract: The Vanity collection's Deliver Item button sends CMSG_CUSTOM_ASCENSION_POINT_SPEND_REQUEST (0x0523) with u8 currency 2 and the u32 item id; HandlePointSpendRequest passes it to DeliverVanityItem, which stores the item only when sObjectMgr->GetItemTemplate answers for it. 86 VanityCollection.dbc items (antlers, horns, back pieces and other cosmetic pieces) had no item_template row, so the button delivered nothing for them. rev_20260922_30_vanity_item_templates adds those rows from Item.dbc and ItemAddon.dbc (INSERT IGNORE). CoA.UnlockAllVanity is on in the test realm, so the character is entitled to every static entry. Expected: requesting Twilight Antlers 560478 and item 2977352 puts one of each in the bags.

steps.label: Deliver the last templated vanity item
The last templated vanity item was delivered
